title: Swift Algorithms: uniqued(on:)
hints: You need a set of *keys* you've already seen.

`for element in self where seen.insert(try key(element)).inserted { result.append(element) }`.
jsBridge: `uniqued(on:)` keeps the first element per key, in order. It's lodash's `uniqBy`. Swift needs the key to be `Hashable`, which JS's `Set` doesn't check.
